name: Van
source: The president of Violet Shokai, a variety store in the flower crown country. Since he also does business in Gloriosa Castle, he decided to open a third store in order to cooperate with the development of the checkpoint town. He's been friends with Lily and Edward for a long time, and he loves Lily, who is also her sister's best friend. She also relates to her in a different way than she does, which is why she is disliked by Edward. He seems to only think of Lily as her friend...?
